tool.name: enhance_image_tool
tool.description: Pre-processes document images to improve quality before analysis. Use BEFORE calling specialists when the image shows: faded text, yellowing, noise, low contrast, skew, watermarks, tinted/colored backgrounds (blue security paper, etc.), repeating background text patterns, institutional seals overlapping content, researcher highlights/annotations overlaid on originals, or other degradation. CRITICAL for watermarked documents: official transcripts, certificates, and legal documents on security paper ALWAYS need enhancement — without it, extractors will misidentify content-rich pages as blank or as security/authentication pages. Supports 13 operations including desaturation (remove color tints), thresholding (binary B&W conversion to strip watermarks/background patterns), and levels (Photoshop-style tonal remapping with auto black/white point and gamma — ideal for maximizing ink-to-background contrast on aged manuscripts). For watermarked/security paper documents, use document_type 'watermarked' with 'aggressive' enhancement_level. For historical manuscripts with period handwriting, use document_type 'historical_manuscript'. Returns S3 URI of enhanced image to pass to subsequent specialists.

image_path.description: S3 URL (s3://bucket/key) or absolute file path to the image to enhance.

image_data.description: Base64-encoded image data. Use this OR image_path, not both.

document_type.description: Type of document for optimized enhancement. 'watermarked' forces desaturate-then-threshold pipeline for security paper, watermarks, colored backgrounds. 'historical_manuscript' optimizes for aged parchment/paper with period handwriting and possible researcher annotations. 'photograph' preserves continuous tonal gradations. 'map' preserves semantically meaningful color. 'legal' preserves multiple ink layers and faint stamps. 'newspaper' handles dense multi-column layouts on degraded newsprint. Default: auto (auto-detect).

session_id.description: Runtime session ID for organizing outputs in S3.

specialist.name: image_enhancer
specialist.description: Enhances historical document images using OpenCV for better vision LLM processing
